title: Marble for sure, but porous.
text:
Marble for sure, but porous.. This marble feels unpolished and porous. There's even a hairline crack in one of the stands I received, though no broken parts. Even one of the rubber pads on the bottom was peeling off, but it's been stuck on ever since I placed it back.

They are heavy and support my books just fine.
